note: 文本交接草稿，音色与音频比例待验，不填时间轴。认证检查仅报Secret引用、命名空间及脱敏结果，不输出token、密码或Secret值。缓存镜像能维持现有服务不代表新节点可拉取；认证错误与网络超时分别调查。

series.title: 镜像拉取交接：认证已缓解，超时仍待查
series.premise: 日班结束前inventory发布暂停，四个旧副本仍服务，三个新Pod无法拉取同一批准镜像。两个返回未授权，一个在不同节点超时。晚班接收部分恢复结果和明确升级条件。
series.outcome: 授权人员修正两个Pod的镜像认证引用后拉取成功，保持发布暂停。第三个Pod仍有间歇超时，仓库未证实全局故障。晚班Raj接收脱敏证据、容量告警门槛和网络支持联系表，约定半小时更新，并禁止通过关闭TLS或泄露Secret绕过。

Anika.role: Inventory owner and authorized credential custodian

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 镜像拉取失败后的退避重试

recycling.note: 本稿只复现既有p001-p350或本场此前表达；未来候选不算实绩。

dialogues.title: 发布暂停，旧副本仍在服务
dialogues.premise: 晚班接班时三个新Pod拉取失败，四个旧副本正常运行。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清交接范围与当前服务可用状态。

lines.en: I'll hand over the inventory issue. Three new Pods have an image pull failure.
lines.zh: 我交接inventory问题，三个新Pod镜像拉取失败。

lines.en: Four old replicas still serve traffic. The rollout is stuck, and we've paused expansion.
lines.zh: 四个旧副本仍服务，发布卡住，已暂停扩大。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, no total outage, right? What's the current capacity margin?
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，没有完全宕机，对吧？现在容量余量多少？

lines.en: Current demand fits those four replicas. Peak demand hasn't been validated for tonight.
lines.zh: 当前需求四副本能承载，但今晚高峰还没验过。

lines.en: That's our blast radius so far. New inventory replicas only, not running application requests.
lines.zh: 目前影响是新inventory副本，不是运行中的应用请求。

lines.en: Don't delete the working replicas. Cached availability isn't a reason to force replacement.
lines.zh: 不要删正常副本，有缓存可用也不能强制替换。

lines.en: So, keep an eye on capacity. Roughly two hours remain before expected peak.
lines.zh: 那么，盯住容量，预计高峰前还有约两小时。

lines.en: I'll check the affected Pod events first. Have we grouped the failures by reason?
lines.zh: 我先查受影响Pod事件，是否按原因分组了？

lines.en: Yes, authentication errors and timeouts differ. Treating all three alike would be misleading.
lines.zh: 是的，认证错误和超时不同，三个都当一样会误导。

lines.en: I'll stay for authentication questions tonight. We won't paste credential values into this handoff.
lines.zh: 我今晚留下回答认证问题，不会把凭据值贴进交接。

dialogues.title: 退避只是状态，不是根因
dialogues.premise: 四旧副本正常，三个新Pod失败原因需分别交代。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解pull backoff不能自行解释认证或网络故障。

lines.en: Pull backoff means retries are delayed. It doesn't identify the underlying failure reason.
lines.zh: 拉取退避表示重试延后，不说明底层失败原因。

lines.en: Let me tail the log. Two Pods show unauthorized; one reports a timeout.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志，两个Pod未授权，一个报告超时。

lines.en: Keep their event timestamps separate. The timeout occurred on a different node.
lines.zh: 分别保留事件时间戳，超时发生在不同节点。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, image pull failure isn't a container crash, right?
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，拉取失败不是容器崩溃，对吧？

lines.en: Right, these containers haven't started yet. Application restart debugging won't explain failed image retrieval.
lines.zh: 对，这些容器还没启动，排应用重启不能解释镜像获取失败。

lines.en: Repeated manual retries may add load. Let normal backoff run while we diagnose.
lines.zh: 反复手动重试可能加负载，排查时让正常退避运行。

lines.en: I'm on it. Our working hypothesis is two causes, not one registry outage.
lines.zh: 我来查，当前假设是两类原因，不是一次仓库全局故障。

lines.en: Maybe the timeout is transient. We need same-node tests before naming its cause.
lines.zh: 超时也许是暂时的，确定原因前需要同节点测试。

lines.en: So, keep both tracks open tonight. Authentication first, then the registry path.
lines.zh: 那么，今晚保留两条调查线，先认证，再仓库路径。

lines.en: I'll confirm the intended credential reference. Only authorized staff will inspect its contents.
lines.zh: 我确认预期凭据引用，只有授权人员检查内容。

dialogues.title: 核引用，不读出Secret
dialogues.premise: 两个Pod未授权，另一节点超时；开始核对认证引用与权限。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出能公开的认证检查结果与禁止泄露的信息。

lines.en: The pull secret reference is wrong. Those two Pods reference the previous credential object.
lines.zh: 拉取Secret引用错了，那两个Pod指向旧认证对象。

lines.en: Does the intended object exist there? Image pull Secrets must share the Pod namespace.
lines.zh: 预期对象在那里存在吗？拉取Secret必须与Pod同命名空间。

lines.en: Yes, the approved object exists there. Managed configuration has the correct reference now.
lines.zh: 是的，获批对象存在于该命名空间，统一配置现在引用正确。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, report status only, right? No tokens or Secret values.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，只报状态，对吧？不报token和Secret值。

lines.en: Also check repository permission and registry host. A valid credential may lack required access.
lines.zh: 也核仓库权限和注册表主机，有效凭据未必有目标访问权。

lines.en: I'm on it through the authorized tool. Access checks pass for the approved repository.
lines.zh: 我通过授权工具检查，对获批仓库的访问检查通过。

lines.en: That supports a reference mismatch here. Don't copy credential material into the issue ticket.
lines.zh: 这支持此处引用不匹配，不要把凭据材料复制到工单。

lines.en: We can rule that out as missing repository permission. Maybe the timeout remains unrelated.
lines.zh: 可以排除缺少仓库权限，超时也许仍是独立问题。

lines.en: For the tested identity, yes. Keep the test scope recorded, without credential contents.
lines.zh: 对已测身份可以，记录测试范围但不含凭据内容。

lines.en: So, apply only the reviewed reference fix. Let pull backoff run; keep expansion paused.
lines.zh: 那么，只应用评审过的引用修复，让正常拉取退避重试继续，保持暂停扩大。

dialogues.title: 状态页正常不代表节点路径正常
dialogues.premise: 认证引用修复获批，第三节点的拉取超时继续调查。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别仓库全局状态与特定节点访问路径的区别。

lines.en: Registry availability looks normal from control probes. That doesn't clear the affected node's path.
lines.zh: 对照探测显示仓库可用，但不能排除受影响节点路径问题。

lines.en: The pull secret reference is correct there. I'll compare DNS, TLS, and connection timings.
lines.zh: 那个节点的拉取引用正确，我对比DNS、TLS和连接耗时。

lines.en: Use the same registry endpoint and image. A public homepage tests a different path.
lines.zh: 用相同仓库端点和镜像，公共首页测试的是不同路径。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, keep TLS verification, right? No insecure registry shortcut.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，保留TLS验证，对吧？不走不安全仓库捷径。

lines.en: Right, the approved trust chain stays unchanged. Our working hypothesis is path-specific delay.
lines.zh: 对，获批信任链不变，当前假设是特定路径延迟。

lines.en: Maybe, but repeated samples are needed. One successful handshake doesn't prove large pulls work.
lines.zh: 可能，但要重复采样，一次握手成功不能证明大镜像拉取正常。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on timeouts. We can rule that out as confirmed global downtime.
lines.zh: 我关注超时，可以排除已证实全局宕机这个说法。

lines.en: Don't clear the registry entirely either. A regional issue could still affect this path.
lines.zh: 也别完全排除仓库，区域问题仍可能影响这条路径。

lines.en: So, preserve that uncertainty in handoff. The incoming shift mustn't inherit a false conclusion.
lines.zh: 那么，交接保留这个不确定性，接班不能继承错误定论。

lines.en: I'll add the exact tested scope. No credential details go in the network evidence.
lines.zh: 我补上准确测试范围，网络证据不含凭据细节。

dialogues.title: 认证修复成功，但不放量
dialogues.premise: 仓库全局故障未确认，认证修复后两Pod开始正常拉取。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清制品未变、已恢复范围和保留发布暂停的理由。

lines.en: Both authenticated pulls succeeded now. They use the approved image digest, not a new tag.
lines.zh: 两个认证拉取现在成功，使用获批镜像摘要，不是新标签。

lines.en: That fixes their retrieval failure only. Startup and application readiness still need checking.
lines.zh: 这只修复镜像获取失败，启动和应用就绪还要查。

lines.en: I'm on it. Both containers started, and readiness checks are successful now.
lines.zh: 我来查，两个容器已启动，就绪检查现在成功。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, keep rollout paused, right? One image pull failure remains.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，继续暂停发布，对吧？还有一个拉取失败。

lines.en: Yes, the timeout still repeats occasionally. We haven't established its underlying cause.
lines.zh: 是的，超时仍偶尔重复，还没确定根本原因。

lines.en: Keeping old replicas is our temporary workaround. Maybe tonight's peak needs additional capacity.
lines.zh: 保留旧副本是临时缓解，今晚高峰也许需要额外容量。

lines.en: Do not switch to an unapproved image. That introduces an unrelated release risk.
lines.zh: 不要换未批准镜像，那会引入无关发布风险。

lines.en: So, I'll keep an eye on capacity. Two recovered Pods remain outside rollout expansion.
lines.zh: 那么，我关注容量，两个恢复Pod不意味着发布可以扩大。

lines.en: Attach the successful pull and startup evidence. Don't label the whole issue resolved.
lines.zh: 附上拉取和启动成功证据，不要标整个问题解决。

lines.en: I'll carry that distinction into handoff. Authentication is mitigated; the timeout track remains open.
lines.zh: 我把区分写进交接，认证已缓解，超时调查仍开放。

dialogues.title: 缓存不能证明新节点可拉
dialogues.premise: 两Pod恢复，第三个仍超时，旧副本继续承载请求。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别已缓存镜像与真实远程拉取测试的差别。

lines.en: One new Pod remains blocked now. That's our blast radius after authentication recovery.
lines.zh: 现在剩一个新Pod阻塞，这是认证恢复后的影响范围。

lines.en: The old nodes have a cached image. Restart success there wouldn't prove remote pulls work.
lines.zh: 旧节点有缓存镜像，在那里重启成功不能证明远程拉取正常。

lines.en: The approved image digest matches everywhere. Our working hypothesis concerns the affected node's path.
lines.zh: 各处获批镜像摘要一致，当前假设涉及受影响节点路径。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, don't clear caches, right? They protect our current working capacity.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，不清缓存，对吧？它们维持当前正常容量。

lines.en: Correct, and don't depend on them alone. A replacement node may need every layer remotely.
lines.zh: 对，也不能只靠缓存，替换节点可能要远程取全部层。

lines.en: So, let's keep it under observation. We'll test pulls without disrupting working replicas.
lines.zh: 那么，继续观察，不打扰正常副本地测试拉取。

lines.en: Use an authorized low-rate test there. Record layer transfer timing and failure stages.
lines.zh: 在那里用获准低频测试，记录层传输耗时和失败阶段。

lines.en: Maybe the timeout depends on image size. Don't change the artifact just to hide it.
lines.zh: 超时也许与镜像大小相关，不要换制品来掩盖。

lines.en: Also distinguish skipped cached layers carefully. Partial cache hits can shorten a test misleadingly.
lines.zh: 也仔细区分被跳过的缓存层，部分命中可能误导性缩短测试。

lines.en: I'll record one unresolved Pod explicitly. Tonight's shift needs that count, not general reassurance.
lines.zh: 我明确记录一个未解决Pod，夜班需要数量，不是笼统放心话。

dialogues.title: 什么情况下不能继续等
dialogues.premise: 一个Pod持续超时，缓存维持现有副本，需规定重试及容量触发条件。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住十分钟超时、容量恶化和不同联系路径。

lines.en: Use a ten-minute retry window first. Persistent timeouts then trigger the network escalation path.
lines.zh: 先用十分钟重试窗口，持续超时就触发网络升级路径。

lines.en: Don't wait if service capacity falls. Fewer than four healthy replicas requires immediate review.
lines.zh: 服务容量下降不要等，健康副本少于四个立即评估。

lines.en: I'm the incoming primary on-call now. I'll page the backup if customer errors rise.
lines.zh: 我是接班主值班，客户错误上升就呼叫备班。

lines.en: Use sustained errors against the agreed alert. A single synthetic failure isn't that threshold.
lines.zh: 按约定告警判断持续错误，一次模拟请求失败不算该阈值。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, authentication regression comes to me, right? Network timeouts go elsewhere.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，认证复发找我，对吧？网络超时走另一条。

lines.en: Yes, keep those contacts separate. Registry support receives sanitized timings, not credentials.
lines.zh: 对，联系人分开，仓库支持接收脱敏耗时，不收凭据。

lines.en: So, normal pull backoff remains enabled. No repeated deletions to force faster retries.
lines.zh: 那么，保留正常拉取退避，不反复删除来强制快重试。

lines.en: Maybe retries recover before escalation. I'll still record the successful path and timing.
lines.zh: 也许升级前重试会恢复，我仍记录成功路径和时间。

lines.en: Check peak demand before releasing the pause. Recovery on one pull isn't release acceptance.
lines.zh: 解除暂停前核高峰需求，一次拉取恢复不是发布验收。

lines.en: I'll remain reachable until the next update. Credential access still follows the authorized process.
lines.zh: 下次更新前我保持可联系，凭据访问仍按授权流程。

dialogues.title: 接班人核证据与未知项
dialogues.premise: 升级门槛和联系人已明确，Raj复核交接证据并提出疑问。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出被纠正的因果推断和脱敏材料的边界。

lines.en: Okay, let me play that back. Sanitized events show two authorization failures and one timeout.
lines.zh: 好，我复述，脱敏事件显示两个授权失败和一个超时。

lines.en: Correct, the authorization failures are mitigated. Registry availability remains unproven from the affected path.
lines.zh: 对，授权失败已缓解，受影响路径的仓库可用性仍未证实。

lines.en: I called it a registry outage earlier. Correction: that's not established by these samples.
lines.zh: 我之前叫它仓库宕机，纠正一下，这些样本没证实。

lines.en: Exactly, the global control probes succeeded. The remaining evidence is path-specific and incomplete.
lines.zh: 正是如此，全局对照成功，剩余证据仅针对路径且不完整。

lines.en: Just to confirm, you'll preserve that uncertainty, right? Have I missed anything important?
lines.zh: 确认一下，你会保留不确定性，对吧？我漏了什么重要事项吗？

lines.en: Maybe tomorrow's rollback needs the same registry. The saved revision alone doesn't guarantee retrieval.
lines.zh: 明天回退也许要同一个仓库，保存版本本身不保证能获取。

lines.en: Good point, test the rollback artifact path. Don't assume old images are available everywhere.
lines.zh: 说得对，测试回退制品路径，别假定旧镜像到处可用。

lines.en: So, a full registry migration, let's park that. Tonight I'll validate only approved artifacts.
lines.zh: 那么，全面迁移仓库先搁置，今晚只验获批制品。

lines.en: The evidence folder contains no Secret values. Access to credential inspection remains separately restricted.
lines.zh: 证据目录没有Secret值，凭据检查访问另行受限。

lines.en: I'll attach the internal evidence link. Customer updates get impact and next steps only.
lines.zh: 我附内部证据链接，客户更新只给影响和下一步。

dialogues.title: 谁负责，什么时候更新
dialogues.premise: Raj已澄清未证实仓库宕机，现确认责任人与半小时更新时点。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分值班协调、凭据责任和网络调查责任。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for authentication? Anika remains the credential owner tonight.
lines.zh: 认证谁接？今晚Anika继续是凭据责任人。

lines.en: Raj owns incident coordination after handoff. Network support owns the timeout investigation once escalated.
lines.zh: 交接后Raj协调，升级后网络支持负责超时调查。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for another update? I'll send one in thirty minutes.
lines.zh: 好，下次更新什么时候？我三十分钟后发。

lines.en: Earlier if service conditions worsen. Don't wait for the scheduled update during customer impact.
lines.zh: 服务恶化就提前，影响客户时不要等计划更新。

lines.en: Just to confirm, status not credentials, right? I'll keep an eye on authentication regression.
lines.zh: 确认一下，报状态不报凭据，对吧？我关注认证复发。

lines.en: Use the access-controlled support record. Include sanitized events and the exact tested scope.
lines.zh: 用访问受控支持记录，包含脱敏事件和准确测试范围。

lines.en: So, maybe another test before peak. Raj, confirm the capacity check stays assigned.
lines.zh: 那么，高峰前也许再测一次，Raj确认容量检查有人负责。

lines.en: I'll own that before peak demand. No release expansion without renewed approval and checks.
lines.zh: 高峰前我负责，重新审批和检查前不扩大发布。

lines.en: I'll stay available for the first comparison. Then the backup contact follows this roster.
lines.zh: 首次对比我保持可联系，之后按这个排班找备份联系人。

lines.en: My authorized access stays with me. Incoming coordination doesn't transfer credential privileges automatically.
lines.zh: 授权访问仍由我持有，接班协调不自动转移凭据权限。

dialogues.title: 接收责任，不伪装问题已解决
dialogues.premise: 责任、证据和更新时点已明确，接班人作最终复述。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出接班确认不是故障解决，并复述仍暂停的事项。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, two pulls recovered. One timeout remains, and release expansion stays paused.
lines.zh: 好，小结，两个拉取恢复，一个超时仍在，发布继续暂停扩大。

lines.en: Four old replicas remain our confirmed capacity. Don't replace them merely to retry pulls.
lines.zh: 四个旧副本是已确认容量，不为重试拉取而替换。

lines.en: Is that your handoff acceptance, Raj? Just to confirm, you've received the evidence, right?
lines.zh: Raj，这算你明确接受交接了吗？确认一下，你收到证据了，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, I've got it from here. The ten-minute retry window and escalation contacts are recorded.
lines.zh: 是的，接下来我负责，十分钟窗口和升级联系人已记录。

lines.en: Registry downtime is still not confirmed. Keep that qualification in every update tonight.
lines.zh: 仍未确认仓库宕机，今晚每次更新都保留这个限定。

lines.en: Maybe authentication could regress again. Page me through the roster, without sending credential contents.
lines.zh: 认证也许会再复发，按排班呼叫我，不发送凭据内容。

lines.en: A successful retry doesn't authorize rollout expansion. Readiness and peak capacity checks still apply.
lines.zh: 重试成功不授权扩大发布，仍需就绪和高峰容量检查。

lines.en: So, we'll close the loop tomorrow. Tonight's next update comes in thirty minutes.
lines.zh: 那么，明天闭环，今晚下一次更新在三十分钟后。

lines.en: I'll attach the final control samples. They document tested paths, not guaranteed future availability.
lines.zh: 我附上最后对照样本，记录已测路径，不保证未来可用。

lines.en: I accept coordination, not unrestricted access. I'll keep impact, mitigation, and open questions separate.
lines.zh: 我接收协调责任，不是无限访问权，分别记录影响、缓解和未决问题。
